newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia fixed-coupon bonds lead domestic market.
newsitem.headline: Russia fixed-coupon bonds lead domestic market.

text.p: Russia's OFZ interest-bearing fixed coupon bonds led gainers in quiet government paper trade on Monday, as investors snatched up the 20 percent paper while most issues stayed below that level, dealers said.
*Average yield fell to 19.51 pct from 19.69 pct on Friday
*Turnover fell to 2.52 trln rbls from 3.22 trln rbls
*The Central Bank did not intervene on the market on behalf of the Ministry of Finance
Dealers said banks preferred to lend roubles rather than investing them in government paper at current levels.
"At the start of trading there was a price fall, but as no one wanted to sell, the fall stopped," said Bank Imperial Securities Department Head Sergei Ivanov.
"The fact that the trading was focused in short and medium-term paper testifies to the fact that there was not much non-resident funds on the market."
Foreign investors generally prefer to buy longer term paper.

Dealers explained the quietness of the market by the absence of fresh funds. Analysts had forecast the next price rise after the shortage of roubles on the interbank market, caused by companies' tax payments last week, was over.
